title: Peach Cobbler with Buttermilk Biscuits
summary: Sliced ripe peaches pre-baked until juicy, then topped with tender buttermilk drop biscuits and baked until golden and bubbling.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: about 3 tbsp; 4 tbsp if the peaches are very juicy

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
cold unsalted butter, cut into 1 cm cubes
demerara or granulated sugar, for sprinkling

steps.title: Start the peaches
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and butter the dish. Halve, pit and slice the peaches 1 cm thick, toss with both sugars, the lemon juice and salt, then the flour, and spread in the dish. Set on the tray and bake 15 min until the juices start to run; this head start means the fruit and biscuits finish together.

steps.title: Mix the biscuits
steps.text: Meanwhile whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, bicarbonate and salt, then rub or cut in the butter until like coarse crumbs with pea-size pieces left. Stir in the buttermilk with a fork just until a shaggy dough forms. Minimal mixing keeps the biscuits light and tender.

steps.title: Drop the dough
steps.text: Drop the dough in about 12 rough spoonfuls over the hot peaches, leaving small gaps, and sprinkle with the demerara. The gaps let steam escape so the biscuit bases cook through rather than turn gummy.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 25-30 min until the biscuits are deep golden, their centres read about 93 °C and the fruit bubbles thickly around them.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Cool 20 min so the juices thicken, then serve warm with whipped cream or plain yoghurt. Serves 8. Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days and reheat at 180 °C (160 °C fan) 15 min.

tips: There is no need to peel the peaches; the skins soften and add colour.
Common mistake: overmixing the dough. Stop as soon as it comes together.
Very juicy peaches need the extra tablespoon of flour.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days and reheat at 180 °C (160 °C fan) about 15 min. The biscuits soften on standing.
